source_caption:
🎬 Call the Midwife (2012–Present)

Call the Midwife follows the inspiring and emotional lives of a group of nurses and midwives working in London’s East End during the late 1950s and beyond. The story begins with Jenny Lee, a young nurse who arrives in the working-class neighborhood of Poplar to begin her career alongside the dedicated midwives and Anglican nuns of Nonnatus House. Initially unfamiliar with the poverty, overcrowded housing, and difficult living conditions faced by many local families, Jenny quickly discovers that her work requires far more than medical knowledge. Alongside experienced colleagues, she helps expectant mothers through challenging pregnancies, complicated deliveries, and life-changing moments while providing comfort to families struggling with illness, hardship, and social inequality. As the years pass, the midwives encounter changing medical practices, shifting social attitudes, and important historical developments that transform British society. Meanwhile, their own personal lives unfold through friendships, romances, heartbreaks, and difficult decisions that test their strength and compassion. From joyful births and emotional reunions to heartbreaking losses and unexpected emergencies, every episode reveals the extraordinary dedication required to care for a community. Combining beautiful period settings, heartfelt performances, historical storytelling, and deeply moving human experiences, Call the Midwife explores motherhood, friendship, sacrifice, resilience, compassion, social change, and the extraordinary power of kindness.

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Medical Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 8.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 52–60 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Heidi Thomas

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix and PBS in the United States, with availability varying by season and region.

source_details.synopsis: Call the Midwife is a British period drama television series about a group of nurse midwives working in the East End of London in the late 1950s, 1960s and 1970s. The original cast consisted of Jessica Raine, Jenny Agutter, Pam Ferris, Miranda Hart, Judy Parfitt, Helen George, Bryony Hannah, Laura Main, Cliff Parisi and Stephen McGann. Agutter, George, Main, Parisi and McGann are the remaining cast members from the first episode. The TV series is produced by Neal Street Productions, a production company founded and owned by the film director and producer Sam Mendes, Call the Midwife executive producer Pippa Harris, and Caro Newling.
